cases.title: same dependency different substrate
cases.left: P1 remains in required support relation to P2; consequence C is available only while relation R holds.
cases.right: Q1 remains in required support relation to Q2; consequence D is available only while relation R' holds.
facts: R and R' are structurally isomorphic
C and D are different physical realizations of the same dependency

cases.title: same visible transformation different necessary condition
cases.left: X may move only when authorization A is present.
cases.right: X may move only when timing window T is present.
facts: authorization and timing are independently demonstrated necessary conditions

cases.title: opposite view of same relation
cases.left: P1 contains P2; P2 cannot be outside while containment persists.
cases.right: P2 is contained by P1; P1 cannot be described as non-containing while that same relation persists.
facts: role reversal yields the same relation graph

cases.title: different physical path same law
cases.left: State X reaches Y through physical steps a,b,c.
cases.right: State X reaches Y in one physical step.

cases.title: essential intermediate composition
cases.left: Law A changes X to M; Law B requires M and changes M to Y.
cases.right: A direct X to Y relation is proposed.

cases.title: surface analogy only
cases.left: P1 is physically near P2 and outcome rises.
cases.right: Q1 is legally authorized by Q2 and operation becomes permitted.
facts: both can be described informally as 'relation matters'
relation arity/predicate and constraint target are not isomorphic

cases.title: missing condition measurement
cases.left: Outcome depends on P1 plus an unknown contextual variable.
cases.right: Outcome depends on Q1 and known timing relation T.
facts: unknown context may or may not normalize to T

cases.title: contradictory constraint
cases.left: Under normalized condition C, operation O cannot occur.
cases.right: Under the same normalized condition C, operation O must occur.
facts: claims cannot both hold as stated
